# Selector Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SelectorType`](gmeow-SelectorType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SelectorType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)

The encoding kind of a region selector — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). SVG path, pixel rectangle, fractional rectangle, polygon, RLE mask, COCO mask, DICOM-SEG mask, and Web [`Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md) fragment are examples; the set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SelectorType`](gmeow-SelectorType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
